hoca.name: Nasreddin Hoca
hoca.desc: Nasreddin Hodja, a cheerful chubby elderly Turkish man with a big round fluffy white beard, rosy cheeks, bushy white eyebrows, twinkling eyes, wearing a huge round white turban and a long green kaftan with an orange sash

komsu.name: Komşu
komsu.desc: Hodja's skinny neighbor, a middle-aged Turkish villager with a thin curly black mustache, a red fez hat and a striped brown vest

esek.name: Eşek
esek.desc: Hodja's small grey DONKEY (a donkey, not a horse) with very long fluffy ears, big front teeth and a goofy grin

zengin.name: Ev Sahibi
zengin.desc: a pompous rich Ottoman man with a huge curled mustache, a tall golden turban and a shiny purple silk kaftan

cocuk.name: Çocuk
cocuk.desc: a cute little Turkish village boy with messy black hair, freckles and a small red vest

beats.say: Bir gün Nasreddin Hoca, komşusundan *kocaman* bir kazan ödünç alır.
beats.img: {hoca} smiling and borrowing a huge shiny copper cauldron from {komsu} at his wooden door, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Ertesi gün kazanı geri getirir. Ama kazanın içinde *minicik* bir tencere vardır!
beats.img: {hoca} holding the big copper cauldron with a tiny cute copper pot sitting inside it, {komsu} staring surprised, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hocam, bu küçük tencere de ne?
beats.img: {komsu} pointing at a tiny copper pot with a very confused face, close-up, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Müjde komşu! Senin kazan *doğurdu*, bu da yavrusu!
beats.img: {hoca} grinning proudly and presenting the tiny pot like a baby, close-up, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Komşu sevinçten havalara uçar. Kazanı da tencereyi de alıp içeri koşar.
beats.img: {komsu} jumping with joy hugging the cauldron and the tiny pot, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Aradan günler geçer. Hoca yine kapıyı çalar ve kazanı yeniden ister.
beats.img: {hoca} knocking on {komsu}'s door again, sly smile, afternoon light, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Ama bu sefer günler, haftalar geçer… Kazan bir türlü *geri gelmez*.
beats.img: {komsu} waiting at his window impatiently tapping fingers, calendar pages flying, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hocam, benim kazan nerede kaldı?
beats.img: {komsu} at {hoca}'s door with hands on hips, frowning, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Başın sağ olsun komşu… Senin kazan *öldü*!
beats.img: {hoca} with a fake sad face holding his hand on his heart, dramatic, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Kazan ölür mü hiç Hocam?
beats.img: {komsu} shocked with eyes popping out and mouth wide open, close-up, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Doğurduğuna inandın da, öldüğüne neden *inanmıyorsun*?
beats.img: {hoca} winking and raising one finger wisely, sunset light, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

publish.title: Kazan Doğurdu! 😂 Nasreddin Hoca #shorts
publish.description: Nasreddin Hoca'nın en sevilen fıkralarından: Kazan doğurdu! Animasyonlu fıkra.

beats.say: Nasreddin Hoca bir gün zengin bir adamın *düğününe* davet edilir.
beats.img: {hoca} in a plain old patched brown robe walking toward a grand lantern-lit Ottoman mansion wedding party at night

beats.say: Hoca eski ve yamalı giysileriyle içeri girer. Ama kimse ona *yüzüne bile* bakmaz.
beats.img: {hoca} in old patched clothes standing alone, rich guests turning their backs, lavish banquet hall with lanterns

beats.say: Sofrada yer bile vermezler. Hoca sessizce evine döner.
beats.img: {hoca} walking home sadly under a starry night sky, cobblestone street

beats.say: Evde en güzel *kürkünü* giyer ve düğüne geri döner.
beats.img: {hoca} proudly wearing a magnificent fluffy fur coat and a big clean turban, admiring himself in a mirror

beats.say: Buyurun Hocam, buyurun! Başköşeye geçin lütfen!
beats.img: {zengin} bowing deeply and welcoming {hoca} in a fur coat, lavish banquet hall, guests smiling

beats.say: En güzel yemekler önüne gelir. Hoca kürkünün yenini *çorbaya* daldırır.
beats.img: {hoca} dipping the sleeve of his fur coat into a big bowl of soup at a lavish banquet table, guests shocked

beats.say: Ye kürküm ye! Ye kürküm ye!
beats.img: {hoca} feeding pilaf to his fur coat sleeve with a spoon, funny face, guests with mouths wide open

beats.say: Hocam, ne yapıyorsunuz? Kürk yemek yer mi?
beats.img: {zengin} confused and embarrassed, mustache drooping, banquet hall

beats.say: Bu ikram bana değil, *kürküme*! O hâlde yemeği de o yesin!
beats.img: {hoca} smiling wisely pointing at his fur coat, warm lantern light

beats.say: O gün herkes anlamıştı: İnsana kıyafetine göre değil, *kalbine* göre değer verilir.
beats.img: {hoca} sharing food with poor village children at the banquet table, everyone smiling, warm golden light

publish.title: Ye Kürküm Ye! 🧥 Nasreddin Hoca #shorts
publish.description: İnsana kıyafetine göre değer verilir mi? Nasreddin Hoca'dan unutulmaz bir ders.

beats.say: Bir gün köylüler, Hoca'yı göl kenarında *tuhaf* bir işle meşgul görür.
beats.img: {hoca} kneeling at the edge of a big beautiful lake holding a small bowl of yogurt, villagers watching curiously from behind

beats.say: Hoca elindeki bir kaşık yoğurdu göle döküyor, suyu karıştırıyordur.
beats.img: {hoca} pouring a spoonful of white yogurt into the lake and stirring the water with a long wooden stick, ripples

beats.say: Hocam, ne yapıyorsun öyle?
beats.img: {cocuk} running up curiously with big eyes, lakeside

beats.say: Göle *maya* çalıyorum evladım! Bütün göl yoğurt olacak!
beats.img: {hoca} grinning enthusiastically stirring the lake, splashes, sunny lake

beats.say: Köylüler gülmekten yerlere yatar.
beats.img: villagers laughing hysterically and rolling on the grass by the lake, {hoca} in background

beats.say: Hocam, hiç göl maya tutar mı?
beats.img: {komsu} laughing and wiping tears from his eyes, lakeside

beats.say: Hoca karıştırmayı bırakır, döner ve gülümser.
beats.img: {hoca} turning around slowly with a calm wise smile, golden sunset on the lake

beats.say: Ya *tutarsa*?
beats.img: {hoca} winking with one finger up, close-up, sunset sparkles on the water

beats.say: Hoca'nın sözü dilden dile yayılır: Denemeden asla *bilemezsin*.
beats.img: the whole village watching the shimmering lake at sunset, {hoca} and {cocuk} smiling together

publish.title: Göle Maya Çalan Hoca: Ya Tutarsa? 🥛 #shorts
publish.description: Nasreddin Hoca neden göle yoğurt döktü? Ya tutarsa!

beats.say: Hoca pazara gideceği gün, köyün bütün çocukları etrafını sarar.
beats.img: {hoca} riding {esek} out of the village, many excited village children running around him, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hocam, bana bir *düdük* getir!
beats.img: {cocuk} jumping up and down asking excitedly, close-up, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Her çocuk bir düdük ister. Ama sadece *bir* çocuk, Hoca'nın avucuna bir bozuk para bırakır.
beats.img: {cocuk} placing a single shiny coin into {hoca}'s palm, other children only shouting, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Akşam olur. Hoca pazardan döner. Bütün çocuklar koşarak gelir.
beats.img: {hoca} returning on {esek} at sunset, crowd of children running towards him, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hoca cebinden *tek bir* düdük çıkarır ve parayı veren çocuğa uzatır.
beats.img: {hoca} handing one wooden whistle to {cocuk}, other children looking surprised and disappointed

beats.say: Düt düt dütttt!
beats.img: {cocuk} happily blowing a wooden whistle with puffed cheeks, sparkles, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hocam, öteki çocuklara neden getirmedin?
beats.img: {komsu} asking with raised eyebrows, children pouting behind him

beats.say: *Parayı veren*, düdüğü çalar!
beats.img: {hoca} laughing and pointing at the happy boy blowing the whistle, golden sunset

publish.title: Parayı Veren Düdüğü Çalar! 🎶 Nasreddin Hoca #shorts
publish.description: Bu sözün nereden geldiğini biliyor musun? Nasreddin Hoca anlatıyor.

beats.say: Bir gün Hoca, öğrencileriyle birlikte camiye gidecektir.
beats.img: {hoca} walking with a group of young students in small turbans, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hoca eşeğine biner. Ama *ters* oturur! Yüzü eşeğin kuyruğuna dönüktür.
beats.img: {hoca} sitting BACKWARDS on {esek}, facing the donkey's tail, smiling, students giggling, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Iiiii-aaaa!
beats.img: close-up of {esek} braying loudly with funny big teeth, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Yoldaki herkes durur, kıs kıs güler.
beats.img: villagers laughing and pointing at {hoca} riding backwards on {esek}, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hocam, eşeğe *ters* bindin!
beats.img: {cocuk} laughing and pointing, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Ters binmedim evladım. Önden gitsem size *sırtımı* dönecektim.
beats.img: {hoca} turned backwards on {esek} talking kindly to students walking behind him, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Arkanızdan gitsem siz bana sırtınızı döneceksiniz. Böylece hepimiz *yüz yüzeyiz*!
beats.img: {hoca} and his students all smiling face to face while walking, golden light, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

beats.say: Hoca'nın bu tatlı inceliği, bugün bile anlatılıyor.
beats.img: {hoca} riding backwards on {esek} into a beautiful sunset, silhouettes, sparkles

publish.title: Hoca Eşeğe Neden Ters Bindi? 🫏 #shorts
publish.description: Nasreddin Hoca'nın eşeğe ters binmesinin ardındaki incelik.

intro.say: Akşehir'de yaşamış, hem bilge hem de *çok şakacı* bir adam düşünün.
intro.img: {hoca} waving happily at the viewer in front of a colorful Anatolian village at sunrise, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

intro.say: Bugün Nasreddin Hoca'nın en komik *beş* fıkrasını izleyeceğiz. Hazırsan başlıyoruz!
intro.img: {hoca} riding {esek} towards the camera with a big smile, children running behind, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines

outro.say: En çok hangi fıkrayı sevdin? Yorumlara yaz!
outro.img: {hoca} laughing with {komsu}, {cocuk} and {esek} together at sunset, in a sunny colorful Anatolian village with whitewashed houses, cobblestone street and grape vines
{hoca} waving goodbye riding backwards on {esek} into the sunset

publish.title: Nasreddin Hoca'nın En Komik 5 Fıkrası 😂 (Animasyon)
publish.description: Kazan Doğurdu, Ye Kürküm Ye, Ya Tutarsa, Parayı Veren Düdüğü Çalar ve Eşeğe Ters Binen Hoca! Nasreddin Hoca'nın en sevilen fıkraları animasyonla anlatılıyor. Her yaştan izleyici için eğlenceli ve öğretici.
